blocks.text: MANILA – Senator-judges are set to vote Wednesday on the number of votes required to convict Vice President Sara Duterte in her impeachment trial, following arguments over whether the threshold should remain at 16. Before adjourning the trial on Tuesday, presiding officer Senator-judge Francis Escudero reminded his colleagues that the reason no witness would be called to the stand on Wednesday “is because we will be hearing the oral arguments of the parties (on the threshold vote issue).” “Each party will be given 15 minutes.
